Kate’s life is practically perfect. She has a thriving career, an amazing best friend, and an incredible fiancé. Then a family accident forces her back to the small town she left over a decade ago. The place that holds some of her fondest memories and her most devastating heartbreaks. Kate now has to balance her high-powered career, planning her dream wedding, and helping her mom recover, all while being apart from her fiancé. The juggling should be simple enough for this type A personality, who loves creating to-do lists and spreadsheets, but every passing day makes her question everything about her so-called perfect life. Including the man she’s supposed to marry. It doesn’t help that he’s back in town—Jake. Her childhood best friend, who abruptly cut Kate out of his life fifteen years ago without explanation. author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!
caption: We can’t discuss “Hungered” without talking about that ending! No spoilers, of course (get to reading!), but it paints a picture of the reality that many families in poverty go through.  Amanda Rizkalla said it herself: “I respect these characters too much to give them an easy, redemptive ending.” If you’ve gotten to the end like us, share below your thoughts on this incredible debut novel! #oprahsbookclub #hungered

author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!
caption: Reading books is always a wonderful reminder that we’re not alone. Natalie joined our book club conversation all the way from Texas to discuss the similarities she saw between herself and Sofia, the protagonist of our 125th book club pick “Hungered.” What moments can you relate to in the story? Let us know below, and keep reading with us. #oprahsbookclub

author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!
caption: Poverty presents itself as a unique kind of trauma because while it may not always be visible, the constant survival mode takes a toll on the mind, especially for a small child or an adult who is responsible for a family.  If you’re reading or relating to the struggles that take place in Amanda Rizkalla’s “Hungered,” know that you are not alone and there is no moral failing for doing the best you can with the circumstances presented to you ❤️. #oprahsbookclub #bookclub #hungered #amandarizkalla

author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!
caption: “Hungered” is such an important story because it’s a humbling reminder that you never fully know what people are going through. Housing instability can happen to anyone, and we should remember to lead with kindness when navigating the world. Get your copy of Amanda Rizkalla’s debut novel wherever books are sold. #oprahsbookclub #hungered #amandarizkalla #bookclub

author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!

author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!

author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!

Pick up your copy of Amanda’s debut novel, “Hungered,” wherever you get your books, and let’s get to reading! #oprahsbookclub #bookclub #hungered #amandarizkalla

author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!

author_bio: Currently reading: "Hungered" by Amanda Rizkalla!
caption: Our 125th book club pick is here, and it’s “Hungered” by Amanda Rizkalla! Told from the POV of twelve-year-old Sofia, the story follows her, her mother, and her brother Rafa as they navigate life while living out of their car after Sofia’s parents separate. In the midst of it all, Sofia still has to attend school and deal with the growing pains of being a preteen while also doing what she can to support her mother brother.  Get your copy of “Hungered” wherever books are sold, and tap the link in our bio to watch Amanda and Oprah’s conversation about our latest book club pick in full. #oprahsbookclub #hungered #amandarizkalla #bookclub
